title: mcGeorge66/OpenForexAI
description: OpenForexAI is an autonomous multi-agent Forex trading framework for MetaTrader 5 (and API), combining configurable AI agents, rule-based scripts, risk-aware execution, and strategy optimization. It supports script-only or LLM-assisted trading with rule-driven Decision Prompts.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: foxmaster77/12BOT
description: 12-agent AI dev team that builds full websites autonomously. Each agent (PM, Designer, HTML/CSS/JS devs, Animator, Backend, DB, 2x Debugger, Docs) runs on a different free LLM API with automatic fallback + local Ollama backup. Visualized as a live 2D office where agents work, debug, or take coffee breaks in real time.

title: DemoMacro/office-open
description: Create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) from plain JSON or fully typed APIs — generate, parse, and patch. Built for AI agents, LLM tool-calling, and hand-written code alike; no Microsoft Office required, opens in every major office suite.

title: mozgsml/memgres
description: Drop-in memory layer for AI agents on a single Postgres. Store documents (not LLM-guessed facts), edit by whole body or unified diff with content-hash optimistic concurrency, organize as an ltree tree, recall lexically or semantically (pgvector) or hybrid, git-blame every line, reconstruct any version, erase for real. Library + HTTP + MCP. MIT.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent
description: TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Describe the goal, not the graph: a coordinator plans the task DAG at runtime and runs it on any LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or local models).

title: axisrow/axdisp
description: Deterministic rule-based decision system for AI agents, without ML or LLMs

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG (FAISS+BM25) over your codebase, a 100+ tool Multi-Turn engine, an 86-agent visual workflow designer, 28 SKILL.md skills, a universal MCP client, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp
description: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: shaumik/PokeArena
description: A Pokémon battle arena where any agent can play — human, deterministic game-tree AI, or LLM — over an open WebSocket protocol (MCP, CLI, or your own client). One leaderboard, ranked by who plays best.

title: agentd-dev/source-code
description: A minimal, MCP-native, cloud-native AI agent runtime. One small static Rust binary runs one agent: hand it an instruction and one LLM endpoint, and it runs the agentic loop — think, call a tool, observe, repeat — until the task reaches a terminal status or a new event wakes it.

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
description: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain language, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local via Ollama.

title: jenolaszlo-sketch/penghou-cangjie
description: Penghou.Cangjie is a lightweight, local-first, provenance-aware context store for .NET AI applications. It provides explicit persistent context, SQLite FTS5 retrieval, scopes, tags, relationships, logical history, and evidence tracking without requiring an agent framework, vector database, or LLM.

title: Orkas-AI/Orkas
description: Open-source multi-agent AI desktop client — build and command your AI agent team through conversation. A commander LLM dispatches sub-agents in parallel or in series; agents self-evolve via reflection and skill crystallization. Local-first, BYO LLM keys (Claude · OpenAI · Gemini · DeepSeek · Kimi · GLM · Qwen). macOS / Windows / Linux.

title: Wanderpath-Travel/wanderpath-agentic-system
description: Wanderpath Travel agents need an AI assistant to handle complex itinerary modifications, process flight upgrades, and check international entry requirements. However, the system cannot give the LLM raw database access to sensitive client payment data, passport records, or the ability to unilaterally execute non-refundable cancellations.

title: tuangel134/BlackClaw
description: On-device AI agent that operates your Android phone — local or cloud LLM and free LLM, ~140+ tools, built-in ADB pairing, OCR, auto-replies. Beta.

title: mockagents/mockagents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: jdorner/palim
description: Self-hosted AI agent platform with extensions, workflows, and a web UI. Local LLM inference via llama.cpp (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
